name: worker jacket
summary: This blue cotton 4-buttoned down shirt jacket with two patch pockets above hem is a women’s jacket, generally known in the West as a jacket of the ‘Mao’ suit or 'gong ren fu' in Chinese, literally means 'worker clothes'.
